info.about.body: WearCraft takes a PBR texture set and generates unique wear variations — so identical assets stop looking copy-pasted.

info.about.feat2: Generate N unique variations with warped wear patterns

masks_info.title: How to use masks
masks_info.intro: WearCraft uses masks to generate rust and dirt. There are two ways to apply them.
masks_info.step1: Open the masks folder using the button below.
masks_info.step2: Put PNG or JPG files there — any B/W images with spots.
masks_info.step3: Return to WearCraft → "Mask library" → tick which to use.
masks_info.about_user_mask: "Custom mask" button takes ONE mask and uses ONLY it. To mix — turn it off and use the Library.
